svg.aria-label: Pixel-art panorama of Russia: the tricolor waving on a golden pole with the golden hammer and sickle on the cloth and the golden double-headed eagle rising behind it, a Su-37 streaking across the starry sky, and a lone traveler in a Soviet ushanka watching from a rooftop — the dream road below runs Tehran, ITMO Saint Petersburg, KFU Kazan
